verdict.rationale: Modal publishes an official Python SDK for deploying serverless applications and interacting with the platform programmatically. It also publishes official JS and Go SDKs for Sandboxes, invoking deployed Functions, and some platform resources, so the story of building against official SDKs is directly delivered. missing for 10: feature parity in the JS/Go SDKs (documented as covering only 'some' platform resources), independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK quality.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: The [Modal](https://modal.com/) Python SDK allows you to deploy high-performance serverless applications and programmatically interact with the Modal platform.
The JS and Go SDKs allow you to use Modal Sandboxes, invoke deployed Modal Functions, and interact with some Modal platform resources.
